subject.title: Dashboard: export / import / share a workspace config

question: Should dashboard workspace import/export/share be sponsored as bundled dashboard plugin work after the Wave 1 stack lands, or should maintainers defer it to external plugin/ClawHub distribution first?
rationale: The feature is useful and aligned with web-frontend ergonomics, but it depends on an unmerged bundled dashboard surface and crosses storage, approval, sandbox, and shareability boundaries that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Sponsor After Wave 1
options.body: Keep this issue open as the Tier 4 dashboard distribution item and require storage/security/API proof once the prerequisite dashboard stack is ready.

options.title: Externalize Distribution First
options.body: Ask contributors to prove workspace package import/export as an external plugin or ClawHub package until maintainers accept bundled dashboard scope.

options.title: Defer Dashboard Sharing
options.body: Leave the roadmap child open but do not queue implementation until the base dashboard and custom-widget approval flow are accepted.

recommendation.title: Sponsor After Wave 1
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the Tier 4 dashboard distribution item and require storage/security/API proof once the prerequisite dashboard stack is ready.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main history signal for the Control UI plugin-tab seam and likely product/security routing for bundled dashboard scope.
